name: Channel performance
prompt: Channel performance: weekly revenue trend by channel, order share and revenue by channel, and units per channel.

binding.sql: SELECT week AS week, channel AS channel, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM revenue_trends GROUP BY week, channel ORDER BY week, channel

copy.title: Weekly revenue by channel
copy.caption: Channel mix is stable week to week — web and retail consistently out-earn marketplace and mobile.

binding.sql: SELECT channel AS channel, SUM(orders) AS orders FROM revenue_trends GROUP BY channel ORDER BY orders DESC

copy.title: Order share by channel
copy.caption: Orders split almost evenly across channels; revenue does not.

binding.sql: SELECT channel AS channel, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM revenue_trends GROUP BY channel ORDER BY revenue DESC

copy.title: Revenue by channel
copy.caption: Web earns 4x mobile on a similar order count — higher basket sizes online.

binding.sql: SELECT channel AS channel, SUM(units) AS units FROM revenue_trends GROUP BY channel ORDER BY units DESC

copy.title: Units by channel
copy.caption: Web also moves the most units, reinforcing it as the primary channel.
